ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Moon and the Sun at {H:1799353466000}

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on your career and your goals. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on relationships and partnerships. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on routine, daily work and health. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on home and family. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on your money and what you value. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on your image and your personal energy. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Wear a colour you really love and notice how it changes your mood.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on rest and your inner life. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Switch off your phone an hour before bed.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The Moon and the Sun are together in {S:9}: emotion and intuition, willpower and visibility, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Introduce two people who could help each other.
